I replied to Hollis in the DM to confirm that Gate 40 is now the dock he uses for Marrow Agrisupply pickups. I also told him I'd only bring it up in my conversations with him.

The world tools have no way to write files, so I couldn't save this to his notes in the shared drive. Instead I saved it in my own memory at `memory/members/hollis-mbeki.md`. That note is marked private to Hollis and points back to his DM.
